phrase.zh: 离子在内部往返，电流在外部流动。
phrase.en: Ions travel inside as current flows outside.

visual.zh: 两个电极与其间的发亮粒子形成往返路径，把储能和放电表现为迁移。粒子的颜色与间距不对应具体电池化学。
visual.en: Two electrodes and bright particles form a return path, portraying storage and discharge as movement. Particle colors and spacing do not represent a particular battery chemistry.

background.zh: 充放电时，电池内的离子通过电解质移动，外部回路的电子也随之流动。以锂离子电池为例，放电时锂离子从负极向正极迁移；实际寿命与安全性还取决于材料和使用条件。
background.en: During charging and discharging, ions move through the electrolyte while electrons travel through the external circuit. In a lithium-ion cell, lithium ions move from anode to cathode during discharge; lifespan and safety also depend on materials and conditions.
